💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Glasswing Darter: Move when the shadow grows. Watch the shadow, not the bug — when it grows, the dive is coming. MOVE while it falls and it lands on dirt. A missed dive grounds it: that's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
